The load-time ANCHOR candy for the `kind: jetkvm` device entity. A flat
external `kind` needs a candy-level reference so its plugin enters the
loader's scan closure: an `add_candy:`-only reference on a deploy node is
NOT seen by `connectDeclaredKindPlugins` (it scans with empty ResolveOpts),
so the word parses but the provider never registers and the entity is
warn-skipped. This candy's `candy:` list carries the plugin-jetkvm ref
that makes the kind provider connect during load (the eval-pr/plugin-
pipeline pattern). See the omarchy-jetkvm-install plan's RDD finding B.

## Acceptance plan
